sentences.en: The gold coin was much more valuable than was supposed.
sentences.zh: 这枚金币比人们想象中的更有价值。

sentences.en: Eating too much fat is supposed to cause heart disease.
sentences.zh: 摄入过多脂肪被认为会导致心脏病。

sentences.en: Suppose you had ten million yen, what would you do?
sentences.zh: 假设有十 million 日元，你会做什么？

senses.zh: 假设；认为；让（虚拟语气）；推想
